book.title: 向日葵为什么朝着太阳
book.subtitle: 幼花苞的追光旅程
book.question: 向日葵为什么朝着太阳？

moral.zh: 幼嫩向日葵受生物钟和光照影响会转动，成熟后茎变硬，通常固定朝东。
moral.en: Young sunflowers turn with light and their body clock; mature flower heads usually settle facing east.

pages.zhText: 清晨，小米在花园里发现：向日葵朝着太阳。
pages.enText: In the morning garden, Mia noticed that the sunflowers faced the sun.

pages.enText: When the flower matures, its stem becomes stiff and usually stays facing east instead of chasing the sun all day.
